# Orpheon source attribution

`crates/ryotunesd/src/spotify/player-bridge.js` is adapted from the player bridge in
[MySpoti/Orpheon](https://github.com/kota-zo/Orpheon), revision
`70f323c5e5c3c21305b3177eb681e84ba02ce872`.

Orpheon is licensed under GPL-3.0. Ryotunes is GPL-3.0-or-later, so this adapted file remains
GPL-3.0-only. The upstream copyright and source notices in the bridge are retained. The bridge
changes are tracked in Ryotunes' source and are covered by the repository's `LICENSE`.

Quackify's player source is not included; its module-level proprietary notice conflicts with the
repository-level GPL notice.
